take:
In these posts TouchDesigner is the real-time engine for interactive art, and the input is usually a body. MediaPipe appears in 6 of these posts, almost always through @blankensmithing's plugin, which @neles0n tries out on camera ([MediaPipe plugin](/e/DFaChZeMdn1)). The clearest example is @pepepepebrick's piece where hand tracking steers two digital spiders over a generated 3D web, with leg count and spider distance mapped to pitch and waveform in VCV Rack ([spider web synth](/e/DW6tpWWMtZV)). Other inputs appear too: @pala3d routes Kinect body data through TouchDesigner into Unreal Engine to drive particle views of NASA and CERN datasets ([DATA CONTROL](/e/DVoReJNCGxT)), and @the.poet.engineer mocks up a non-functional gesture interface where a pinch delegates work to an agent ([gestural agent UI](/e/DctoIMltaNN)).

The technique posts go deeper than the demos. @as.ws__ explains storing parametric equations in image pixels, since color is a vector, so one texture can hold many equations that build forms like jellyfish ([equations as images](/e/DSqaoDMEpaJ)). At DATLAB, @blankensmithing and @dotsimulate present free components for training classifiers on any CHOP data, from gestures to EEG, and point out the classifier is a search algorithm rather than machine learning ([Classifier TOX](/e/DYaNXZJx_L3)). 3D scanning with Polycam and Gaussian splats show up as companion techniques ([creative coding guide](/e/891906d4212e)).

The gaps are mostly in what the posts leave out: many are silent process clips with no patch shown, such as a circular light array ([ARRAY](/e/DcqCWk9CP76)). @ojrgb voices mixed feelings about "Claude can do this in 10 minutes" captions watering down a deep craft ([mixed feelings](/e/DXOWz4yjN--)). The Gemini Omni news tag is incidental. The full hand-tracking setup is collected in [the MediaPipe to TouchDesigner pipeline](/guides/mediapipe-touchdesigner-pipeline). It fits installation artists and creative coders comfortable with node-based patching.
